---
name: Feature request / 功能建议

labels: enhancement
---

## Problem / 问题

What terminal or Codex workflow is difficult today? / 当前哪个终端或 Codex 工作流不方便？

## Proposed behavior / 建议的行为

Describe the smallest useful change. / 请描述最小且有用的改动。

## Platform impact / 平台影响

Would this need to work on macOS, Linux, WSL, or all three? / 该功能需要支持 macOS、Linux、WSL 中的哪些平台？
